rationales: Cancer is abnormal cell growth, not accidental cell death.
Apoptosis is programmed cell death, not accidental cell death.
Necrosis is the accidental death of cells and living tissues.
Metastasis is the spread of cancer cells to other parts of the body.
Phylum is a taxonomic rank above class, not the basic unit.
Class is a taxonomic rank above order, not the basic unit.
Species is the basic unit of biological classification.
Order is a taxonomic rank above family, not the basic unit.
The nucleus stores genetic material and controls cell activities, but is not the major energy-production centre.
Ribosomes make proteins and do not produce most of the cell’s energy.
The cell membrane regulates movement of substances into and out of the cell.
Mitochondria are the major centres of energy production in cells.
Plants generally have cell walls.
Animals do not have cell walls.
Fungi have cell walls.
Bacteria have cell walls.
Lipase breaks down lipids.
Proteins are broken down by proteases, not lipase.
Carbohydrates are broken down by carbohydrate-digesting enzymes, not lipase.
Hormones are not the specific substrate of lipase.
Glycolysis does not occur in the vacuole.
Glycolysis does not occur on ribosomes.
The Golgi complex modifies and packages substances; it is not where glycolysis occurs.
Glycolysis takes place in the cytoplasm.
Churning is the mixing of food, especially in the stomach, not the wave-like muscle movement along the gut.
Emulsification is the breakdown of fats into small droplets.
Absorption is the uptake of digested nutrients.
Peristalsis is the wave-like contraction and relaxation of the alimentary canal’s smooth muscles.
Physics studies matter, energy, and their interactions.
Chemistry studies substances and their properties and reactions.
Biology is the scientific study of living things.
Farming is an applied activity, not the scientific study of living things.
Medicine is the broader practice of preventing and treating illness; transplantation is an operation.
Kidney transplantation is an example of surgery.
Physiology studies how living organisms and their parts function.
Lithotripsy breaks up stones and is not kidney transplantation.
Biologists do not use only two senses for observation.
Biologists do not use only three senses for observation.
Biologists do not use only four senses for observation.
The five senses—sight, hearing, smell, taste, and touch—are used for observation.
Potato’s scientific name is Solanum tuberosum.
Carrot’s scientific name is Daucus carota.
Allium cepa is the scientific name of onion.
Pea’s scientific name is Pisum sativum.
Mitochondria have an internal matrix rather than stroma.
Ribosomes do not contain stroma.
The Golgi body does not contain stroma.
Stroma is the fluid-filled region inside a chloroplast.
A hypertonic solution has a higher solute concentration than the comparison solution.
An isotonic solution has the same solute concentration as the comparison solution.
A hypotonic solution has a lower solute concentration than the comparison solution.
A hydrophyte is a plant adapted to living in water, not a type of solution.
Prophase is one stage of mitosis and is not where cells spend most of their life.
Cells spend most of their life in interphase, growing and carrying out normal functions.
Metaphase is a brief stage of mitosis when chromosomes align.
Telophase is the final stage of mitosis and is relatively brief.
Pepsin is a digestive enzyme, but it is not the general answer for enzymes used in biological detergents.
Proteases break down protein stains and are used in biological detergents.
Glycogen is a storage carbohydrate, not an enzyme.
Trypsin is a protease, but the general enzyme category used in biological detergents is protease.
